The attention function is performed in parallel on each of these projected versions, yielding $d_v$-dimensional output values. these outputs are then concatenated and projected again to produce the final values. This approach allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions, a process that is inhibited by averaging in a single attention head.
